name: hcapp_rptKennelRunStats
description: Authenticated passthrough to HC6.nonApi_rptKennelRunStats (db/hc6/app): the kennel's pivoted run-stats matrix — one row per run, one column per hasher, the cell encoding attendance, hare status and payment in a single integer. Read SP, no success envelope. Auth: HC6.ValidateAppAuth (spNumber 51, @param NULL — device-secret token). No permission gate: any signed-in hasher may report on any kennel; the helper is not told who is asking. On auth failure a single error rowset is returned and the SP returns; otherwise the helper's rowset is streamed through at index 0. The body is wrapped in TRY/CATCH (lines 63-74): an unhandled error is logged to HC.ErrorLog and re-raised (THROW), so the client sees an HTTP 500 but the failure is recorded.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Registered device UUID. Passed to ValidateAppAuth to resolve the calling user and their device secret. No SQL default.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived cryptographic token validated by ValidateAppAuth against the device secret. No SQL default.

parameters.name: kennelId
parameters.description: Kennel to report on. Passed straight to HC6.nonApi_rptKennelRunStats after auth succeeds; not checked against HC.Kennel. No SQL default.

rowsets.name: AuthError
rowsets.description: Returned only when ValidateAppAuth rejects the request (bad token, unknown or signed-out device). Single rowset — there is no success/errorCode/errorType envelope in front of it.

columns.name: errorId
columns.description: Unique ID of the HC.ErrorLog entry logged by ValidateAppAuth.

columns.name: errorCode
columns.description: Specific error code within the errorType category.

rowsets.name: KennelRunStatsPivot
rowsets.description: Returned on the success path, produced by HC6.nonApi_rptKennelRunStats via sp_executesql PIVOT. One row per visible, non-removed run of the kennel that has at least one attended HasherEventMap row (AttendenceState >= 20, TotalRunsThisKennel set), ordered by Event_date DESC, plus two sentinel summary rows ('Run totals' dated 2200-01-01 and 'Times hared' dated 2100-01-01). The four fixed columns below are followed by ONE COLUMN PER HASHER named by the hasher's DisplayName (plus a 'Visitors & Virgins' column for rows whose hasher id equals the kennel id), ordered by run count descending. The per-hasher cell is an encoded INT: (DebitAmount * 10000 + PaymentType, or 99990000 when no uncancelled payment) + 100000000, negated when the hasher hared; NULL when the hasher did not attend. On the summary rows the cell is the hasher's run count or hare count instead. Clients must read the column list dynamically.

columns.name: Event_name
columns.description: Event.FbEventName when Event.UseFbRunDetails = 1, else Event.EventName; 'Run totals' / 'Times hared' on the two summary rows.

columns.name: Total_hashers
columns.description: Count of HasherEventMap rows with AttendenceState >= 20 for the run; NULL on the summary rows.

columns.name: Event_date
columns.description: CONVERT(datetime2, Event.EventStartDatetime) — the raw column, which carries a spurious +00:00 on many rows (see /hc-event-datetimes); 2200-01-01 / 2100-01-01 sentinels on the summary rows.

sideEffects: None on success (the helper builds and drops a #rpt temp table).

INSERT HC.ErrorLog then THROW on an unhandled error — once by the helper's CATCH (userId NULL, HcVersion '<unknown>') and again by this SP's CATCH (userId set, HcVersion from the device), so one failure produces two log rows.

codeSmells.detail: Lines 3-5: @deviceId, @accessToken and @kennelId have no SQL default. A client that omits any of them gets 'expects parameter ... which was not supplied' before the procedure runs — an empty 500 with no HC.ErrorLog row. Give every parameter a default and check for NULL inside (CLAUDE.md, 'SP parameter with NO default').

HC6.nonApi_rptKennelRunStats lines 122-130 build the PIVOT statement as a string and run it through sp_executesql, against the project rule 'No dynamic SQL. Ever.' The column names are hasher DisplayNames, bracket-escaped (']' doubled) — safe from injection, but a DisplayName that is blank is excluded and a very long name list can exceed the pivot column limit, failing the whole report. The helper's header documents the trade-off; it is recorded here because this SP is the only API-facing route to it.
@kennelId goes straight to the helper (line 65) without checking it names a kennel. An unknown id yields an empty pivot with no error signal, indistinguishable from a kennel with no attended runs.

codeSmells.issue: No permission gate on another kennel's financial data
codeSmells.detail: The pivot cell encodes each hasher's payment amount and type per run. Any authenticated device can request any kennel's matrix; nothing checks that the caller is a member or officer of @kennelId. If this is intended (the HC5 behaviour), it should be stated in the authorizations skill.

breakingChanges: Auth model changed from HC5 inline device lookup + HC.CHECK_ACCESS_TOKEN_V2 call to HC6 ValidateAppAuth helper SP — callers must pass a token generated by the HC6 auth flow.
Error rowset column set changed: HC5 error rowsets included 'debugMessage'; HC6 error rowset (from ValidateAppAuth) does not expose debugMessage to callers — it is logged internally only.
HC5 had a @timeWindows typo (extra 's') in the local variable name — corrected in HC6 to @timeWindow. No caller-visible impact.
1.1.0 (2026-10-13): contract corrections only — the helper is now HC6.nonApi_rptKennelRunStats in source control and its pivot shape is described; the TRY/CATCH smell was retired (added 2026-07-19).
